summaries.name: Spinach and Feta Quiche
summaries.summary: Spinach and Feta Quiche is a variation of the basic quiche recipe, made by adding 1 cup fresh spinach leaves and 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese to the egg mixture. The user chose to try this variation for dinner on 2023/03/15, planning to use fresh eggs from their coop, of which they had 20 dozen stocked in the fridge at the time.
